name: Mt. Yougou
description: The Grand Narukami Shrine sits at the top of the mountain along with the Sacred Sakura. Beside the mountain at the base is a large pool of Electrified Water that drains HP. After completing Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual, the pool becomes de-energized. The Version 2.0 livestream mentions that the mountain is related to the legend of tengu.
